editorial_review_row.content: GBE Brokers scores 6.8/10 from NAFT in 2026. A CySEC-regulated broker (licence 240/14) with a German office in Hamburg that adds genuine operational credibility beyond the typical Cyprus-only setup. Raw spreads from 0.0 pips with $7 round-turn commission on the Classic account, 500+ instruments across forex, commodities, shares, indices, and crypto CFDs. EUR 20,000 ICF investor compensation for CySEC entity clients. The JFD Group acquisition in April 2026 signals serious growth ambition. The catch: EUR 1,000 minimum deposit prices out casual traders, brand recognition remains low outside German-speaking markets, and the review base is too thin for strong community trust signals. Legit and properly regulated — built for traders who already know what ECN pricing means and can meet the entry threshold.
